course_name: 深度學習應用開發實務
outline: The goal of this course is to give students a broad overview of state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms, and teach students how to develop deep learning applications by hands-on coding examples. Most examples taught in this class are based on the TensorFlow framework. We will cover many different fields including image classification, object detection, natural language processing, reinforcement learning and generative adversarial networks.
schedule:
Course website: http://www.aiotlab.org/teaching/dl_app.html

1.	Introduction to Deep Learning
2.	Applied Math (Linear Algebra, Probability, Calculus)
3.	Machine Learning Basics
4.	TensorFlow & Keras
5.	Convolutional Neural Networks  (CNN)
6.	Advanced Keras API & PyTorch
7.	Natural Language Processing (NLP), Word Embedding, Self-supervised Learning
8.	Midterm exam
9.	Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) & Long Short-term Memory (LSTM)
10.	Attention is all you need! Attention and Transformer
11.	Large Language Models (LLMs), ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek
12.   Agentic AI: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and more
13.	Object Detection and Segmentation
14.	Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and Diffusion models
15.	Deep Reinforcement Learning and Stable Baseline
16.	Graph Convolution Networks (GCNs)
17.   Group Study and Presentation
18.	Final exam
